sections.html:
Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and other liver cancers require a coordinated approach between medical oncologists, hepatologists, interventional radiologists, and surgeons. Treatment depends on liver function, tumor extent, and overall health.

The introduction of immunotherapy-targeted therapy combinations has significantly improved outcomes in advanced HCC, and our practice offers access to these treatments along with clinical trials.

sections.title: Treatment Options

sections.html:
What causes liver cancer?

Chronic hepatitis B or C, cirrhosis from any cause, heavy alcohol use, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease are the leading risk factors.

Is immunotherapy used for liver cancer?

Yes. Immunotherapy combined with targeted agents is now first-line treatment for advanced HCC, offering significant improvements in survival.
